title: LIQUID ORB: a refractive liquid sphere
license: Technique reference only: rebuild it in code; never paste the site's output.
use: A glossy liquid sphere as the piece's living object: an SDF metaball (2-4 blobs) raymarched in a fragment shader (three.js / @remotion/three or a raw WebGL canvas), with fresnel rim light, a palette-tinted environment gradient, and refraction that distorts a REAL capture seen through it. Its surface can pulse with the music's energy curve and split/merge on downbeats. Seed every motion by frame.
